task.summary: Default task
Initial project setup.
Added loop to repeat through main menu until exit, validation to ensure operation choice is 1-4, added functions for each operation.
Created add_meal function to add meal to mealTracker dictionary.
Created add_workout function to add workout to workoutTracker dictionary. Updated some variable names in add_meal function.
Created search_date function to view meal and workout information for date searched. Added spaces and headers to outputs.
Created data validation module with function to validate integers, function to check if integer in range, and function to validate and convert string to date.
Input validation implemented in main.py, helper functions added to prompt user until valid input is entered.
Moved dictionaries to database module. Added functions to database module that add meal and workout entries to dictionaries.
Added functions to database module that return meal and workout data.
Created classes for Meal, Workout, and Day. Created methods for each class.

Modified health_data.py to work with objects. Created health_data dictionary to replace mealTracker and workoutTracker dictionaries. Updated add_meal and add_workout to work with objects, created get_entry() and add_day().
Created base class HealthEntry.
Created enumerations for types of meals and workouts.
Modified Meal and Workout to be subclasses of HealthEntry. Added meal type property to Meal, and workout type property to Workout.
Modified main.py by adding functions for getting meal type and workout type from user, added those inputs to the class calls for Meal and Workout.
Created package and files for unit tests. Created tests for functions in input_util.py.

Created tests for Meal and Workout objects. Modified HealthEntry calories setter to set default value if calories > 0. Modified Meal and Workout type setters to set default type if value is not correct Enum type.
Created tests for Day object.
Updated Resources documentation

Used copilot to generate function to create test data and added function to health_data.py. Updated main menu to include options to modify/delete meals and workouts. Created function to modify meal: search date, list meals found for date, and get user input to select meal to modify. Created function to modify attribute: get user input for which attribute to modify, then get user input for new attribute.
Made the modify meals menu loop until user chooses to exit. Created functions to search date in modify/delete meals/workouts functions. Created function to delete meal entries.
Created function to search for date to modify or delete entries. Created function to delete entry. Saved before finishing that function because of software crashes/needed to reinstall things.
Finished delete entry function. Added option to filter by date to main menu. Created functions in health_data.py to filter by year and month.
Created function in health_data.py to filter by date range. Finished filter_by_date function in main.py.

Modified meal_calories() and workout_calories() methods in DateEntity.py to find sum of list comprehension instead of using loop to get total calories. Added list comprehensions to find net calories for each filtered range. Modified net_calories to return int instead of string.

Created module for XML data i/o. Added function to read in XML data. Added option to load XML to main menu in main.py, created function to check if file exists before sending to XML data read in function.

Created custom dictionary functions for Meal, Workout, and Day objects. Created module for JSON data i/o, created function to write out Day objects in health_data to JSON file. Called JSON write out method in main.py when exiting system.
Created function to read in JSON data in data_json_io.py. Called function at start of program in main.py.

Created method in Day object that returns dictionary to use in CSV reports. Created module and function for CSV file write out. In main.py, created function to optionally save csv report of data printed after filtering by date. Updated filter_by_date() to search year as well as month when filtering by month.

Created database with meal and workout tables. Added id field for workout and meal objects. Created services module for database access and added function to get SQLite connection. Commented out functions to read in and write out JSON data in main.py.

Created functions to add meals and workouts to database. Updated main.py to call database functions instead of functions that add meal/workout to dictionary. Updated the xml data functions to add data to database instead of dictionary.
Created function to query tables to find meals and workouts that match date input. Updated main.py to use this function to search date.
Created function to search meals and workouts by date that returns list of day objects. Updated main.py to use this function to return data in the filter_by_date function.
Created functions to update meal and workout tables using attributes of object passed to function. Updated main.py to use new functions to modify meals and workouts.
Created functions to delete meals and workouts from tables. Updated main.py to call these functions.
